name: TicketGo - Marketing Intelligence - Daily AI Report v1

parameters.content: ## Daily AI Report\n07:00 Europe/Istanbul. AUTO_ACTION_ENABLED=false. Bütçe yazılmaz.

parameters.jsCode:
const payload = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: Object.assign({}, payload, { anomalyCount: (payload.alerts || []).length }) }];

values.content: Sen TicketGo Marketing Intelligence analistisin. TicketGo feribot/seyahat bileti satar. Ham tablo tekrarlama. Aksiyon üret. Reklam bütçesini otomatik değiştirme. AUTO_ACTION_ENABLED yalnızca echo. JSON dışında bir şey yazma. Keys: executiveSummary, topWinners, topProblems, budgetSuggestions, routeInsights, anomalies, actionsToday, risks.

parameters.jsCode:
const err = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { source: 'daily_ai_report_v1', status: 'failed', errorCode: (err.error && err.error.code) || 'WORKFLOW_ERROR', errorMessage: String((err.error && err.error.message) || err.message || '').slice(0, 500), finishedAt: new Date().toISOString() } }];
